description: Official event baseline and eligible-gathering denominator remain pending; this bounded open-web scan cannot establish a complete event universe.
required_followup: Coordinator to apply official baseline and revise coverage.

description: Searches covered broad and weekly English terms, sector/episode-boundary and regional queries, and one Dzongkha-script query. Local-language results were mostly unrelated; the open-web search is not a systematic archive or LexisNexis-equivalent.
required_followup: Review with a native-language researcher and systematic Bhutan/local regional sources when available.

description: No candidate for a Bhutan-located March gathering was established in captured results. A lack of search results is not evidence of no event, particularly where local-language and archive coverage is incomplete.
required_followup: Use official baseline and systematic local archive review before absence claims.

description: All retained leads are search_only; no bodies were requested. Search snippets alone do not establish any potential gathering’s full chronology, participant threshold, demands, or response.
required_followup: Fresh exact-URL gate plus manual origin and restriction review is required before body access.

description: The BBS Assam strike and GJM strike leads concern neighboring India and vehicle movement; the BBS result is dated 2016, while the GJM result lacks an established event date. They are not evidence of Bhutan-located events.
required_followup: Retain source scope and geography; resolve only if separate cross-border research is commissioned.

description: The Morang refugee-related item does not establish whether a public gathering occurred, when, its target, or attendance. The 2018 Nepal rally and May Hague rally are out-of-period/out-of-country leads.
required_followup: Do not code as a Bhutan event or continuation; retain uncertainty in sources and exclusions.
